fml.menu.mods.info.description.wayfarers:
A cozy parchment map that lives inside your Atlas.

- Minimap and full world map drawn from real block colours, with relief, water depth and biome tints
- Cave view, day and night (torches and lava glow in the dark)
- Markers with 100 pixel-art icons, shareable in chat
- Every Atlas keeps its own map: lose it and the map is gone, give it to a friend and they see what you explored
- Wayfarer's Map Table: share explored lands and markers between Atlases; places you only saw on the table stay faded until you visit them
- Atlas pages: Creature Radar (mobs with their faces) and Death Point (a marker where you died)
- Atlas slot: an Atlas kept there is not dropped when you die
- Ruler, trail of the last minute, other worlds on the map
- Teleport from the map (for operators)

Open the map with J. Settings: Mods > Wayfarer's Atlas > Config.
